text:
nina: support reports customer sees duplicate token billing after a stream resume that hits a different shard and then a toolcall gets truncated. anyone seen orphaned provisional allocations like this?

sam: any req ids? quick log snippet?

nina: req_20260315_21. snippet: ```{ "session":"s21", "provisional_tokens": 60, "resume_route":"eu-west-1-b", "toolcall_truncated": true, "confirmed_tokens": 150 }```

maria: likely provisional wasn't released on original host before resumed host confirmed. we should emit provisional_id and resumed_session on ledger rows to join events.

danny: short term: analytics dedupe by session/resume id within 2m window. long term: carry provisional_id in router so resumed host can claim/clear.

sam: i'll add x-resume-session header and telemetry flag toolcall_truncated=true.

ops-bot: Incident INF-3333 created: "orphaned-provisional on resume+truncate" assigned eng-platform

nina: action items recorded. post traces and I'll run query once telemetry arrives.
